description: Retrieve one How pulsar compares catalog entry by its id, e.g. silesia-pulsar, silesia-gzip9, silesia-xz6. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use measure_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the How pulsar compares catalog, e.g. silesia-pulsar, silesia-gzip9, silesia-xz6. Get the id list from measure_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: measure_get
